# vMLX 1.6.80

## Models and inference

- Add MiMo-V2.6 image, video, audio and tool support, bundled DFlash detection, and SSD-backed conversations. Restore ordinary decoding when the drafter is disabled.
- Add Nemotron-3.5 Bolt and Super-VL, including native vision support and compatible Super-VL MTP. LiLiCorr remains optional and off by default.
- Improve long-document prefix reuse, prefill cancellation, and background cache persistence. Preserve native model sampling and existing speculative decoding defaults.

## Images

- Add Qwen Image 2.1 and Turbo generation/reference editing and compatible Ideogram 4 generation.
- Add native SeedVR2 resolution and softness controls, saved output dimensions, structured FIBO captions, and explicit Flux2 Klein editing.
- Preserve image adapter selection across requests, new sessions, and deep sleep; validate unsupported controls clearly.

## App and API

- Keep earlier MiMo media in Responses follow-ups; return recoverable errors for rejected tool output without executing invented tools or automatically retrying generation.
- Fix remote-session switching, preserve string-valued GLM tool arguments, and keep large text pastes responsive.
- Explain why changing tools or thinking can invalidate a long chat's prefix cache. Show tool-loop prompt usage as a total across requests.
- Include JANG 2.5.50 Nemotron vision modules and qualified MFlux 0.23 / Pillow 12.3 dependencies.

Performance depends on the bundle, prompt, sampling, context and device state. Speculative decoding can benefit code or long-context workloads while remaining slower than ordinary decoding on some prose workloads; this release does not promise a universal speed floor.

Use the Tahoe build on macOS 26 or newer for native Metal kernels. The Sequoia build supports macOS 14.5 and newer.
